limits: Stop on missing/incomplete evidence, unconfirmed process/workspace cleanup or the enclosing deadline. Record partial batches honestly. No product deadline, target source, action, expectation or input timing changes; no automatic retry of failed attempts.
execution_policy: Run after the active Yazi application jobs finish, before another target acquisition. Source preparation, public attempts, failure evidence and checked cleanup stay in the job-owned checkout.
disposition_policy: Retain the original failed run and all new attempts. Zero observed recurrences permits only a bounded unreproduced-risk disposition for this exact host/contract/candidate, never a zero-flake claim.
